parts.text: I worry about the service being restarted or updated during working hours while drones are flying, or crashing, though we accept a few minutes of interruption. I also worry that the links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment are unreliable, meaning an instruction might get through twice and the sender often cannot tell if the first attempt arrived. Furthermore, radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, which means reports from drones can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all.
